item.text:
`npm run sync` fails because the `shared` configuration provides `PAYMENTS_KEY` but no `PAYMENTS_API_URL`. The script then falls back to `127.0.0.1:9`, where nothing is listening.

I updated [src/sync.js](/private/tmp/envtest.yjRXbP/shop-api/src/sync.js:3) to report the missing setting instead of attempting that connection. I verified that `npm run sync` succeeds against a local test server when `PAYMENTS_API_URL` is supplied.

**I still need the real payment API base URL** to make the command work against your service. Please provide it or point me to where it’s documented.
